title: VeriPy Source-Preserving Verification and Compatibility Checking for Python Components
abstract: arXiv:2610.02814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Keeping a Python program and its formal guarantees aligned is a continuing maintenance problem. Specifications must describe the implementation that actually runs, and updates must preserve the behavior on which existing callers depend. VeriPy brings these obligations into a common workflow for annotated Python components. Developers and agents express contracts, invariants, and proof hooks as Python comments, then refine checked auxiliary lemmas using source-located diagnostics. Direct encoders produce Dafny or Lean artifacts while retaining admitted executable bodies and explicit models of their dependencies. A relational product checks whether an updated component still admits old inputs and preserves returned values and modeled exceptions. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.02814v1 公告类型：新 摘要：保持Python程序与其形式化保证之间的一致性是一个持续的维护问题。规格说明必须描述实际运行的实现，而更新必须保留现有调用方所依赖的行为。VeriPy将这些义务纳入针对带注解Python组件的统一工作流中。开发者和智能体以Python注释的形式表达契约、不变量和证明钩子，然后利用源代码定位的诊断信息来精炼已检查的辅助引理。直接编码器可生成Dafny或Lean工件，同时保留已被接受的可执行函数体及其依赖项的显式模型。通过关系积检查，可以判断更新后的组件是否仍然接受旧输入，并保留返回值和建模的异常。由此产生的工作流将源代码级别的证明开发与功能验证以及向后兼容性连接起来，并记录每项保证所适用的前提假设。代码已公开……
tldr: VeriPy提出了一个统一工作流，使开发者能以Python注释形式表达契约和证明钩子，自动生成Dafny/Lean验证工件，并通过关系积检查更新组件的向后兼容性。
en_tdlr: VeriPy introduces a unified workflow that allows developers to express contracts and proof hooks as Python comments, generates Dafny/Lean verification artifacts directly, and uses a relational product to check backward compatibility of updated components.
